licence.scope: EUMETSAT website terms of use (step 2: the owner's website terms), the same statement class as Beijing1__SLIM6 (ESA website terms, permission). GERB-2 flies on Meteosat Second Generation; the GERB Ground Segment Processing System page SVO cites (https://ggsps.rl.ac.uk/information.html#Spectral, RAL Space / STFC) carries no copyright or licence statement and no credit request, so it is not the licence source. The terms cover EUMETSAT website content, not explicitly the curve numbers; the page SVO cites for the instrument is the Harries et al. 2005 BAMS paper. The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
